BlogPosting.headline: Why Did the PMO Move Out of South Block? The Story Behind India's New Seva Teerth
BlogPosting.description: India's PMO has relocated to the new Seva Teerth complex. Here's why South Block was left behind and what Seva Teerth and Kartavya Bhavan mean for Indian governance.

itemListElement.name: Why Did the PMO Move Out of South Block?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seva Teerth is the new administrative complex in New Delhi that houses the Prime Minister's Office, the Cabinet Secretariat, and the National Security Council Secretariat, formally inaugurated in February 2026.
No. South Block still stands. The move relocated which offices operate where; it did not involve demolishing the historic buildings on Raisina Hill.
Kartavya Bhavan is the adjoining complex housing several central ministries, including Finance, Defence, Health and Family Welfare, and Education.
